run_postman_client_example: run the postman client example that connects to localhost and tests identity functions
create_postman_client: create a postman client instance that connects to a server at localhost:12345
test_client_identity: test the client identity method by sending a torch tensor and verifying the return value
test_client_batched_identity: test the client batched identity method by sending a torch tensor and verifying the return value
review_client_pyfunc: review the client pyfunc method that sends a torch tensor to the server and returns output
